# Symbolic System Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SymbolicSystemKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The domain or kind of a symbolic or notation system — a value, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence; new domains may introduce further kinds without ontology modification.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind`](gmeow-SymbolicSystemKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the domain axis of a symbol system — mathematical, musical, stenographic, cryptographic, emoji, gesture, and so on — referenced from a system via [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-kind subclasses (kinds are individuals on an open vocabulary) and avoid using a kind to record the role a notation plays in a particular use — that is [`gmeow:NotationUsageRole`](gmeow-NotationUsageRole.md), a distinct axis.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded kind individual from a system via [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md) (or [`gmeow:notationSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-notationSystemKind.md)); add new individuals, not subclasses, when a domain needs a finer kind.

### Examples

- ex:abc a [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md); [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md) [`gmeow:symbolicKindMusical`](../individuals/gmeow-symbolicKindMusical.md).
